entities.name: MBS Interest Indication procedure
entities.description: Procedure to inform the network that the UE in RRC_CONNECTED state is receiving or is interested to receive MBS broadcast service(s) and to inform the network about the priority of MBS broadcast versus unicast reception.

entities.name: MBSInterestIndication
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network indicating MBS broadcast service interest and priority relative to unicast reception.

entities.name: SIBx1 acquisition
entities.description: System information block acquisition message from network to UE.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an established RRC connection with the network.

entities.name: AS security activated
entities.description: Condition that Access Stratum security must be activated before MBS Interest Indication can be sent.

relations.description: The MBS Interest Indication procedure involves sending the MBSInterestIndication message.
The procedure includes SIBx1 acquisition from the network.
The procedure requires the UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
MBSInterestIndication message can only be sent after AS security activation.
